fact: On 14 September 2026 SPIN and GABON FIBER S.A. concluded a 20-year partnership to run the national backbone, taking over 1,782 km from Axione's concession ending November 2026, as a wholesale-only operator giving access on transparent, equitable and non-discriminatory terms, with 1,651 km of extensions planned.
title: Backbone National Gabonais : la SPIN et GABON FIBER S.A. lancent une nouvelle phase de développement
publisher: Société de Patrimoine des Infrastructures Numériques (SPIN)
